checks.quote: Aircall supports two ways to authenticate with the REST API: Basic Authentication and OAuth.
1. Open your Aircall Dashboard. 2. Go to Integrations > API Keys page. 3. Under API Keys, click Generate API key. 4. Copy your API ID and API Token.
